messages:
alex.k: FYI I'm seeing a persistent 99th tail increase on prod for model-r50 since ~02:12 UTC. 50->420ms on 99th, p95 also nudged. KV cache hit-rate dropped from ~88% to ~52% at the same time. Any recent runtime changes?

maya: noticing the same in our dashboard. latency spike aligns with a selector change in the logs.

alex.k: pasted the selector lines I pulled from the node where the spike started:```
[2026-03-15T02:12:14Z] kernel-selector: selected kernel=matmul_generic fallback=true reason=shape_mismatch dims=[1,1024]
[2026-03-15T02:12:14Z] kernel-selector: selected kernel=fused_attention_v2 perf_est=0.8
[2026-03-15T02:12:15Z] kernel-selector: selected kernel=matmul_generic perf_est=1.5 reason=kv_cache_miss
```

samir: hmm matmul_generic is a slow fallback. Why is kernel-selector choosing that? Could be shape inference or quantization policy mismatch. Also look at admission logs — saw lots of queueing.

liwei: I pulled the admission metrics around the window: `admission.queue_len` jumped from 2->18 and `microbatch.size` oscillated. Looks like a burst that caused KV cache churn.

samir: here's a short pprof snapshot (top stacks):```
100ms kv_cache::lookup_lock
  70ms admission::wait_loop
  30ms kernel_selector::choose
50ms matmul_generic::run
```
That aligns with KV lock contention + fallback to matmul_generic increasing compute time.

maya: infra-bot shows a deploy at 02:11:48 — commit `d3f5a7c` pushed admission tweaks and a kernel-selector tweak for shape heuristics. @liwei was that change in canary?

liwei: yes, I rolled the admission threshold change to canary then to prod at 02:11. commit `d3f5a7c` toggled `admission.max_inflight = 200` -> `300` and changed `kernel_selector.shape_margin = 0.05` -> `0.12`.

alex.k: ok that explains the extra admission headroom leading to larger bursts hitting the cache and exposing a noisy shard that loses hot KV entries. Reverting?

liwei: I can roll back the shape_margin tweak (it's safe) and reduce max_inflight to previous value. Doing a targeted canary rollback to one pod now.

oncall-bot: rollback initiated: service=model-runtime node=cell-17 pod=runtime-17b commit=d3f5a7c->d2a4b11 at 02:15:02 UTC.

samir: after rollback (02:16) I'm seeing 99th drop back toward baseline in that cell. KV hit-rate recovered to ~85% within 40s.

maya: tentative root cause: a combination of admission headroom increase + kernel-selector shape margin change produced larger, more variable microbatches that thrash a specific KV shard and force selector to pick generic matmul for some requests. noisy neighbor (hot shard) amplified tail.

alex.k: agreed. short action items: 1) revert shape_margin in prod (liwei), 2) add a small guard on microbatch size variability (samir), 3) add a KV shard health check and reactive rebalancer (maya). I'll open a perf incident postmortem with traces and pprof.

liwei: done with rollback to previous kernel selector config on canary and prod (02:18). watching.

samir: I'll run a synthetic load to repro the admission+kv churn and capture a longer pprof flamegraph.

alex.k: thanks everyone. please drop any logs/trace links into the postmortem. :thumbsup:
